text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority with a transactional update regarding the redevelopment of the former City-owned above-grade lands at 50 Cumberland Street / 37 Yorkville Avenue (Municipal Car Park 15).

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 12, 2024) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority remain confidential in its entirety at the discretion of the City Solicitor, as it contains a position, plan, procedure, criteria or instruction to be applied to any negotiations carried on or to be carried on by or on behalf of the local board.
